title: ZuCo 2.0: EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading and Annotation
description: ZuCo 2.0 is a multimodal neurophysiological dataset comprising simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recordings from adult native English speakers during natural reading and semantic annotation tasks. Participants read Wikipedia sentences under two conditions: normal reading and task-specific reading with semantic relation annotation. The dataset includes high-resolution physiological signals (500 Hz sampling) with synchronized gaze, pupil, and ocular event data, providing a rich resource for investigating the neural and oculomotor correlates of reading comprehension and linguistic processing.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 128-channel EGI Geodesic system at 500 Hz with Cz reference. Eye-tracking was simultaneously acquired using an EyeLink 1000 system at 500 Hz (left eye). Participants performed two reading tasks: normal reading of Wikipedia sentences and task-specific reading with semantic relation annotation. Eye-tracking data include gaze and pupil samples (physio format) and derived ocular events (fixations, saccades, blinks) in events.tsv files.
